notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only User-agent:* and a Pinterestbot group); ran full tier-1 curl_cffi HTTP sweep. Site is protected by Akamai Bot Manager that alternates between a hard CPR_Block ('Site Maintenance' page) and a JS behavioral-sensor challenge depending on path/timing - both were hit and passed through on retry with a different TLS impersonation profile (safari15_5/chrome124/chrome131/safari17_0) and ~6-8s pacing; no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome escalation was needed since tier-1 eventually succeeded on every URL that matters. Checked for a genuine Bestsellers/Best-Sellers/Top-Sellers/Most-Popular/Customer-Favorites/Trending-Products PLP via: (1) full rendered homepage incl. Lighting mega-menu, Decor/Furniture mega-menu, and the 'Sale' mega-menu (thumbnails: All Sale, Clearance, Open Box - no Bestsellers thumbnail); (2) homepage promo banner grid (Labor Day Event, Great Glow Up Sale, New & Trending, Clearance, Open Box - no bestseller banner); (3) footer link columns (About/Stores/Customer Service/Resources - no bestseller link); (4) sitemap-category.xml (only two merchandising-style URLs present site-wide: sales_on-sale and sales_clearance-items; no bestseller/trending sitemap entry); (5) guessed URL /c/bestsellers_view-best-sellers/ and site-search path /s/best-sellers/ - both returned the Akamai CPR_Block page on two attempts each with different TLS profiles/pacing, so their existence could not be confirmed or denied (treated as inconclusive, not as evidence of absence). No dedicated, undifferentiated 'Bestsellers' PLP was found anywhere in real navigation or the sitemap. The only site listing that touches a popularity/trending concept is /c/trendingitems_view-new-and-trending-items/ ('New & Trending' homepage banner), which combines newly-added items and 'trending' items into a single undifferentiated facet bucket (facet name 'trendingitems', id 269) with no way to isolate a trending/bestseller-only subset - recorded below with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than silently excluded or silently trusted, per brief section on ambiguous cases. This same URL/qty is also recorded in na205.json for the New Arrivals side of the same ambiguity - a human should adjudicate which (if either) file it truly belongs in.

rows.evidence: H1 'View New And Trending Items', span class=result '38,641 results', JSON field "search_results": "38641"
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: AMBIGUOUS BESTSELLERS - this is the only site listing touching a popularity/trending concept ('Now Trending'/'trendingitems' facet id 269), but it is explicitly titled 'New AND Trending' and mixes newly-added products with trending products in one undifferentiated bucket; no pure Best-Sellers/Top-Sellers/Most-Popular-only listing exists in nav, footer, or sitemap. 38,641 results is a large fraction of the catalog (a single sub-category, Chandeliers, alone runs ~19-27k), consistent with a broad merchandising tag rather than a tight bestsellers curation. A dedicated site-search probe (/s/best-sellers/) and a guessed direct URL (/c/bestsellers_view-best-sellers/) both hit Akamai's CPR_Block wall (inconclusive, not proof of absence).
